Just FYI we are actually starting to work on an official test suite now, to detect those kinds of implementation issues earlier benchmark results for the new format proposal are in: https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/issues/152#issuecomment-634322526 looks like the additional AES doesn't make a difference

excerpts.content: hey all, was playing around in an eth2 DHT.. and someone's implementation is sending a NODES response which has 15 associated responses. i.e the total = 15.
